title: Three Monkeys (bc30)
synopsis: See no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil – unfortunately that does not stop evil from existing. Eyup, the patriarch of a poor Turkish family, works for a wealthy politician. One day, his boss kills a man in a car accident and pays him to be the scapegoat. While Eyup is in prison, his son gets into trouble and his wife becomes the politician's mistress. How does Eyup family fall apart, when the crime is not even committed by him? That same year, bc presented a retrospective of Nuri Bilge Ceylan at HKAFF. From then on, all of his films have been screened at bc.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 非禮勿言、非禮勿聽、非禮勿視。大好的家庭因一宗意外命案而無情地摧毀，駕車肇事的政客老闆為了保住前途，說服司機代他頂罪。司機因利誘選擇成為替罪羔羊入獄後，妻子隨即被政客引誘，紅杏出牆。年幼兒子目睹着眼前的虛偽與無情，默不作聲。一家三口，各懷心事。政客在司機出獄後突然被殺，又將三人捲入更複雜的漩渦。導演魯里比茲舍蘭擅玩人性心理，細緻入微，在暗場交代的情與事，突顯人類內心的黑暗面之餘，又詩意盎然。同年 bc 在香港亞洲電影節辦了舍蘭的回顧展，自此他的電影都會引入。

cast: Yavuz Bingöl, Hatice Aslan, Ahmet Rifat Sungar
